current.text: He is Sacramento's backup point guard. The roster has no third point guard.
Sacramento gave him DNPs and low minutes last season and at times kept him out of the rotation.
Coach Doug Christie and the front office are reported to dislike him.
Experts do not trust Sacramento to give him a large bench role, and they do not expect him to get back to a 29-minute role.
Sacramento could give bench minutes to Nique Clifford instead of him.
Trade rumors about him continue. He has 2 years left on his contract, including a player option.
The expert calls him a really good player but says to avoid him at his ESPN rank of 94.
Experts expect Sacramento to finish near the bottom of the league. Lloyd thinks the team will likely trade or sit its veterans.
Coach Doug Christie is on a cheap contract and is under the most pressure in the organization.

durable.text: He does not play defense and cannot hold up defensively for heavy minutes.
He has no flagged weak category. His profile is a mild plus in FT%, threes and assists, with low rebounds and steals.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD (ranks 217 and 161), and he went for 2 USD in our auction last year. That puts him outside the 144 players we draft, and the experts say to avoid him because Sacramento does not trust him with minutes. Leave him on waivers.
